description.p: Gobble Clock plans every step of a slow cooked Thanksgiving turkey from its weight and the time you want to carve. It follows the method from howtocookathanksgivingturkey.com: 20 minutes at 475°F, then 20 minutes per pound at 250°F.

ul.li: Full schedule from turkey weight and carve time
Thaw planner that tells you when to move the turkey to the refrigerator
Cooking mode with a countdown and a reminder at every step
Printable checklist for the refrigerator door
Calendar export and a history of every year's turkey
